changes.text: Reference ownership/order for this static kit: image 1 is accepted ArmedReady209 frame0, the ONLY character/fixedaxe/camera identity and the full-body leg-proportion reference. Image 2 is the actual extracted legless Rest249 component, used ONLY as same-identity pelvis/overlap-construction and approximate part-proportion context. Image 3 is the official three-slot layout. Image 4 is the generic part-role guide. Do not copy the Rest image as a full-body/leg pose or redefine the identity from it. The PNG canvas sizes and alpha-box heights are fitting artifacts, not a common physical scale: do not shorten the legs because Rest is legless, and do not enlarge parts to match image2 canvas bounds. Exact socket pivots, fixed lengths and cross-kit art-unit conversions will be authored from actual reviewed component sources later; no measured anatomy is supplied. Generate only the three expressly named separated limb components below, with one consistent illustration density inside this kit.

changes.before: The other attached images are production layout/part-role guides ONLY, not character/style or measured anatomy references.
changes.after: The additional extracted Rest249 image is only pelvis/upperbody construction and approximate part-proportion context for the SAME acceptedReady209 identity; it is not a new identity, measured anatomy, motion pose or ground/standing-height reference.
